mathematical_review: The ordered rank-one endpoint identity gives rank Z=delta for 6ell+delta factors on 6ell dimensions. Nilpotent full sites have Z_ii=1.

In the common simultaneous basis, disjoint actual full-stage supports make both cross-pairings zero. Their principal Z submatrix is exactly an identity matrix, so every disjoint-support matching has size at most delta.
Any maximal matching, not necessarily a maximum matching, has a union hitting every full-stage support. Because each actual support has size at most three, the union has at most 3delta coordinates.

Each full stage contributes its positive body size to at least one core coordinate. The sum of full-stage body sizes is (8+16+16+8)ell=48ell, while total body load counted with actual stage multiplicities is (2*8+3*16+3*16+2*8)ell=128ell.

For 0<rho=delta/ell<=1/3, padding the core to exactly 3delta coordinates is possible and preserves the load lower bound. The uniform load on that padded core would be 64delta, strictly less than 48ell in this range.

For fixed core size and total load, the two-part concave moment decreases as core load moves above its uniform share: its derivative is H prime at the core mean minus H prime at the outside mean. Consequently substituting the lower core load 48ell gives an upper bound.
After dividing by ell, the resulting root bound is B(rho)=3rho H(1+16/rho)+(6-3rho)H(1+80/(6-3rho)). Each term is a concave perspective, so B(rho)-N-rho lies below its tangent at rho=1/6.

At rho=1/6 the two tariff arguments are exactly 97 and 171/11. The stated derivative follows from d[c H(1+A/c)]/dc=H(x)[kappa+(1-kappa)/x]. Both endpoint bounds of the affine tangent on [0,1/3] are strictly negative.
For rho>=1/3, unconstrained Jensen gives 6H(67/3)-N-rho<=6H(67/3)-N-1/3, also strictly negative at both goals.

Delta=0 is separately impossible because rank Z=0 contradicts a nilpotent full-site diagonal equal to one. Thus the two priced ranges and this algebraic case cover every nonnegative integer thin-query count.
complete_invoice_review: N=6L+4H16+2-2H17 is correct. The two complete binary children cost 4H16+2-4H17 beyond native leaf costs, while consumption of two H17 child outputs adds back 2H17. L already includes the entire native paid-minus-helper invoice. Root thin calls contribute delta H1. There is no duplicate credit for consumed helpers and no missing binary-child debit.
script_review: Integer-rank tariff intervals are combined into rational-rank tariffs by positive denominator interval division, which is valid because H(a/b)=H(a)/H(b).
Negative interval coefficients swap endpoints correctly in scale; subtraction of N and negative tangent coefficients is outward.
The maximum of the two affine tangent endpoints covers either derivative sign. The lower endpoint rho=0 is used only for the affine majorant, not as a feasible construction.
The exact rational upper bounds for both ratio ranges were independently parsed and checked negative. Their reported overall upper enclosure is at least their exact maximum.
independent_numerical_crosscheck: A separate 60-digit Decimal calculation from the pinned paid/helper profiles agrees with both goal bounds. This is a numerical cross-check only; certification comes from the reviewed outward-rational script and the exact proof.

paid_rank_two_to_three_promotion_review.scope: Any subset of the original rank-two A/D full stages may be promoted to actual rank three with its additional whole H8 idle fully paid.
argument: Select the hitting core from the actual supports before trimming. Their sizes remain at most three, so the matching/core rank proof applies unchanged.
Every actual promoted three-set meets the core. One coordinate can always be deleted while leaving a two-set that still meets the core.
Deleting this size-eight body occurrence and refunding its paid H8 changes the margin by H8-[H(x+8)-H(x)]>=0 for x>=1, by concavity/subadditivity of the tariff.
After all trims the same core remains a hitting set, core body mass is at least48ell, and total body mass is128ell. No algebraic or intersection property is asserted for the trimmed incidence sets.
The baseline core moment bound therefore also upper-bounds every such paid-promotion construction. Ranks above three and new-helper promotions are outside this extension.
